home.hero_subtitle: Explorations in high-performance rendering, interface design, and the philosophical implications of software engineering.

about.hero_desc: I'm a Full Stack Engineer and UI/UX Designer obsessed with the intersection of performance and aesthetics. I build high-end web applications that feel alive, using modern architecture to solve complex problems with elegant code.
about.timeline_2024_desc: Leading the migration to Next.js App Router and establishing the new enterprise design system. Focusing on performance optimization and developer experience.
about.timeline_2022_desc: Designed award-winning interfaces for high-end luxury brands using WebGL and advanced micro-interactions. Bridged the gap between design and engineering teams.
about.timeline_2019_desc: Built scalable microservices and laid the foundation for the core product API. Learned the importance of type safety and robust backend architecture.
about.timeline_2016_desc: Wrote the first line of code. Obsession with pixel perfection and logical structures began here.
about.philosophy_quote: We are not just writing code; we are architecting the lens through which humanity perceives reality. Speed is a feature. Beauty is a function.
